system.description:
Battle Amp

While in this state, you gain the following benefits;

You generate +1 Ingot at the beginning of each of your turns.

You DR is set at 12. If your DR is instead higher than 12, increase your DR by +2.

At the beginning of each of your turns, you gain 8 Temporary hit points.

Weapons made by your Liquid Metal trait, or under the effects of your Metallurgy clan feature, count as any weapon group, for the purposes of casting Bukijutsu.

Armor made by Metallurgy can gain a second trait.
system.summary: An Ingot and 8 temp HP each turn, DR set to 12 (or +2 if higher). Your metal weapons count as any group, and armor takes a second trait.

rules.text: DR becomes 12; if it's already higher, +2 (at the table).
